advancedQuery.pageDescription: Configure model list endpoints, token usage fields, and currency exchange rate

general.pathMustStartSlash: Path must start with a slash (/)
general.upstreamDescription: Default endpoint path for fetching the model list from a provider
general.defaultEndpointHint: The path must start with a slash (/); it is appended to the provider's Base URL. When "Fetch models from upstream" in the provider form has no dedicated endpoint configured, this path is used as the fallback.
general.ownDescription: The publicly exposed hapiy model list path
general.ownEndpointHintPrefix: The path must start with a slash (/). When accessed, hapiy returns its known model list in OpenAI-compatible format (
general.ownEndpointHintSuffix: ), authenticated with a Bearer Token and called the same way as other public endpoints.

billing.cardDescription: Currency and exchange rate for all amount display and billing, including usage logs and model info
billing.currencyHint: After switching currencies, historical usage logs keep the currency and amounts recorded at write time; only newly created records are affected.
billing.rateHint: Click "Refresh" to fetch the latest rate online; click the gear button on the right to configure the rate source API address, the CNY rate field, and auto-refresh.
billing.rateMustBePositive: Exchange rate must be greater than 0
billing.invalidUrl: API address must start with http:// or https://
billing.missingField: Please provide the CNY exchange rate field path
billing.savedButRefreshFailed: API configuration saved, but refresh failed: {{message}}
billing.exchangeDialogDescription: Configure the API used to fetch the USD/CNY exchange rate online: request the API address via GET and read the CNY rate field from the returned JSON.
billing.apiUrlHint: This is an address reachable via a GET request; the returned JSON must contain a CNY exchange rate field.
billing.fieldHint: The field path of the USD/CNY exchange rate in the returned JSON. Dot-separated paths are supported, e.g. rates.CNY.
billing.autoRefreshHint: When checked, the latest rate is fetched from the API daily; if an auto-refresh fails, it retries automatically half an hour later.

baseUrl.pageDescription: Append a source tag after the Base URL to distinguish request sources; recognized automatically
baseUrl.cardDescription: Configure the system's public Base URL for Agent software integration
baseUrl.originHint: The domain (including scheme and port) of the system's public Base URL. Used to generate proxy configs and for managed "Follow system"; defaults to the current web page domain. Change it to the public address in tunnel/reverse-proxy scenarios.
baseUrl.sourcesCardDescription: Add a suffix after the Base URL to tag each request's source, so usage logs can be grouped and filtered.
baseUrl.sourceExampleNoteSuffix: in the Source column of usage logs.
baseUrl.sourceMarkerHint: Start the suffix with __ and pick any name; without one everything still works.
baseUrl.sourcesInUseHint: Names you put in an agent's address show up here once a request uses them.
baseUrl.sourcesInUseEmpty: No source-tagged requests in the usage logs yet

other.title: Enable Agent Takeover
other.pageDescription: When enabled, the sidebar shows the "Agent Takeover" entry for managing takeover files and rules
other.toggleDescription:
When enabled, the sidebar shows the "Agent Takeover" entry (config files, rules, etc.).
When disabled, the entry is hidden from the sidebar.
other.mcpDescription:
Expose hapiy gateway data (providers, models, usage, request logs, topology, managed configs) to MCP-capable AI tools; provider configuration is writable.
While disabled, /mcp answers 404.
other.mcpKeyEmpty: Not generated yet; enabling the switch creates one
other.mcpRotateHint: Regenerating invalidates the old key immediately; connected clients must be updated.
other.mcpClients: Client setup (opencode / Claude Code) is documented under "MCP Server" in the help docs.
other.webSearchDescription: Used by the agent for external information. Set a SearXNG endpoint to use your own instance; leave it empty to query Bing directly.
other.webSearchSaveFailed: Failed to save the search endpoint

recovery.probeHint: Polling interval: 0 = off; ≥ 60 recommended; default 60. Recovery probes are re-validated against the failover rule that disabled the entity (TTFB/speed/keywords); if the rule was deleted, only connectivity is tested.
recovery.timedHint: After disabling, recovery happens automatically when the countdown reaches zero; the countdown starts from the moment of disabling, and after switching to this mode it starts immediately from the save time.
recovery.cardDescription: Periodically checks disabled items; automatically clears them once the upstream recovers.
recovery.recordsDescription: Disabled records whose upstream is still failing; you can test the upstream manually. They are removed from the list after recovery.
recovery.handlerButtonTitle: Saves the request at the moment of disabling, then simplifies and stores it per the JSON rules
recovery.fetchRecordsFailed: Failed to fetch records pending recovery
recovery.intervalInvalid: Interval must be a non-negative number
recovery.timedMinutesInvalid: Timed recovery duration must be a positive number
recovery.pastDeadlineLead: Automatic recovery for this disabled record has exceeded the configured recovery duration
recovery.pastDeadlineTail: . You can release it now, or extend its recovery duration and re-evaluate next cycle.
recovery.handlerDescription: The request is saved at the moment of disabling and simplified per the JSON rules below; rules are skipped automatically when a field does not exist.
recovery.noRules: No rules yet. Click "Add rule" to start configuring
recovery.timeoutHoursLabel: Auto-recover records with a missing request body after timeout (hours)
recovery.timeoutHoursHint: Records without a request body, such as gap-filling, are automatically restored after being disabled for this duration; 0 means no wait.

backup.pageDescription: Choose the modules to back up; both automatic and manual backups follow the current selection.
backup.contentHint: Check the modules to back up; usage logs and request captures are unchecked by default. The saved selection applies to both automatic and manual backups.
backup.noChangeHint: Compared with the last backup, when nothing has changed no new file is written — only a “no changes” record is kept.
backup.locationDescription: Backup files are stored on the computer running the background service; a relative path is resolved to an absolute path automatically.
backup.historyDescription: Every backup run; restore any entry.
backup.createdUnchanged: No changes since last backup; no new file was written
backup.noChangeRestoreDisabled: No new file in an unchanged record
backup.restoreWarning: This overwrites the current data of the backed-up modules with the backup from {{time}}. A safety backup is written first; the overwrite cannot be undone.

theme.pageDescription: Choose the themes used for dark and light mode, and install shadcn themes.
theme.modeDescription: Pick which theme each mode uses. "Default" is the built-in theme.
theme.installedDescription: Paste a shadcn theme JSON URL to install it. Deletion is permanent.
theme.confirmDeleteDescription: Theme "{{name}}" will be removed. This cannot be undone.
theme.installDialogDescription: Paste a shadcn theme JSON URL, for example https://ui.shadcn.com/r/themes/zinc.json.
theme.invalidTheme: Could not parse a theme from that URL

reverseProxy.title: Reverse-proxy domains
reverseProxy.pageDescription: Configure the reverse-proxy domains allowed to access the Vite development server.
reverseProxy.description: Domains added here are allowed to access the development server. Restart Vite after changing them.

debug.nodeInfoDescription:
After selecting a node/slot, its info is printed to the console (example):

[ExecutorDebug] slot pslot-test (provider)
  ✓ entry: entry-test enabled=true weight=1
  ✓ slot:  pslot-test enabled=true deadline=always-on
  ✗ self: prov-test enabled=false
  ✗ rule: diverse-exploration status=true autoDisabled=false workflow=true
  == final verdict: disabled (provider)

When a single entry is selected, its full individual verdict is printed.
debug.flowLightsDescription:
Each run prints the following three kinds of info (example):

[FlowLights] request b3f2.. model=deepseek-v4-flash provider=deepseek source=request-fact path=entry-test→pslot-test→prov-xxx→…
[FlowLights] run#12 step 3/16 loop#0 activate node prov-xxx
[FlowLights] run#12 step 4/16 loop#0 activate edge entry-test→pslot-test
[FlowLights] verify prov-xxx -> deepseek: status=true autoDisabled=false workflow=true   (matched)
[FlowLights] skip logOutput-..: node switch is off   (when unmatched, the reason is given: switch off/externally disabled/countdown expired/provider record unmatched)

tokenUsage.footnote: Takes effect immediately after saving: when recording a request's token usage, the system reads the four counts (input / cache write / cache read / output) from these paths in order.
tokenUsage.fieldSuffix: : tried in order, stopping at the first field that exists

profile.pageDescription: Manage account information and change the login password
profile.securityDescription: Update the login username and password
profile.passwordFieldsRequired: Please fill in all password fields
profile.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
profile.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match

affinity.pageDescription: Requests from the same session (Session + model) reuse the last channel first, so multi-channel rotation does not split the context
affinity.enableHint: When off, Session/Model fields are not read and topology selection applies normally.
affinity.sessionFieldsLabel: Session ID headers (one per line, case-insensitive)
affinity.sessionFieldsHint: Only headers are searched (the body is not read); the first one with a value takes effect.
affinity.sessionFieldsCommon: Common field names: X-Session-Id, X-Conversation-Id, x-litellm-session-id, X-Request-Id, X-Client-Session-Id, X-Claude-Code-Session-Id
affinity.modelFieldsLabel: Model fields (gjson paths, one per line)
affinity.modelFieldsHint: Looks up the model name in the request body by gjson path; when empty, the request's model field is used directly (OpenAI standard).
affinity.ttlHint: Counted from the session's most recent successful request; once expired, topology selection applies again.
affinity.sessionRequired: Add at least one Session ID header before enabling
affinity.loadFailed: Failed to load channel affinity configuration
affinity.saveFailed: Failed to save channel affinity configuration

page.baseUrlDescription: Configure the public Base URL; a suffix tags where each request came from
